description: Ex Fuerza Aérea del Perú FAP-185 (1968), to the FAA 5 June 1982 as C-433, renumbered C-633 in 1987, upgraded to Mara 1991, damaged at Tandil 11 June 1998; the Río Gallegos monument aircraft that fell in a 2013 storm, since installed as gate guardian at the aero club from November 2016 with a Finger/Kfir nose cone in Dagger colours. Photographed January 2018 and January 2019.
